title: selaginella rupestris f. haydenii
intro: Selaginella rupestris f. haydenii, commonly known as Hayden's spikemoss, is a species of flowering plant in the Selaginellaceae family. It is a type of ancient, vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body and mind, and it is also used to support the immune system and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of Hayden's spikemoss include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
